title: SAEE: A Frozen Empirical Phase Space Object for Studying Convergent Computational Evolutionary Dynamics
description: SAEE is presented as a frozen empirical phase space object derived from a constrained computational evolutionary system exhibiting strong attractor convergence and bounded diversity. This Zenodo package establishes the public scientific definition of SAEE, reports local observational results, summarizes phase-space findings, and records falsifiable candidate laws without disclosing implementation details.
notes: Local metadata draft only. No Zenodo upload, DOI assignment, repository release, tag, package upload, manuscript submission, or external validation has been performed. The package contains observational and definitional materials only and excludes implementation, runtime, kernel, fitness, selection, mutation, lineage, and reproduction internals.
